title: IllegalArgumentException when parsing Accept Header
body:
### Describe the bug

I've seen [34858](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/34858), but it seems that the Issue has resurfaced, because I can reproduce it with version 3.15.1

When sending a request with a header "Accept: Any", the following Stack-Trace can be found in the logs and the HTTP Code is 500. The fix for the former Bug-Report was in ClassRoutingHandler, but this class is not in the Stack-Trace I got:

### Expected behavior

HTTP 406

### Actual behavior

HTTP 500 and an Exception in the log

### How to Reproduce?

Send request with "Accept: Any" to an endpoint like this:

```java
@Path("/{context}/files")
@RolesAllowed("user")
class MyController(val jwt: JsonWebToken) {
    @GET
    @Path("/{id}")
    @Parameters(Parameter(name = "User-Language", `in` = ParameterIn.HEADER))
    @Produces("application/json")
    fun getFileById(
        @RestPath("context") contextId: UUID,
        @RestPath("id") fileId: UUID
    ): FileGetDescription {
       return FileGetDescription();
    }
}
```
